DO $$
DECLARE
    n BIGINT;
BEGIN
    SELECT count(*) INTO n
      FROM nexus.catalog_documents o
      JOIN nexus.catalog_documents t
        ON t.tenant_id = o.tenant_id
       AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
       AND t.source_uri = CASE WHEN starts_with(o.source_uri, 'chroma://') AND NOT (starts_with(split_part(substr(o.source_uri, 10), '/', 1), 'rdr__') OR starts_with(split_part(substr(o.source_uri, 10), '/', 1), 'docs__') OR starts_with(split_part(substr(o.source_uri, 10), '/', 1), 'code__')) THEN 'nx-note://' || substr(o.source_uri, 10) WHEN o.source_uri ~ '^nxexp://[^/]*/chroma://' AND NOT (starts_with(substring(o.source_uri from '^nxexp://[^/]*/chroma://([^/]*)'), 'rdr__') OR starts_with(substring(o.source_uri from '^nxexp://[^/]*/chroma://([^/]*)'), 'docs__') OR starts_with(substring(o.source_uri from '^nxexp://[^/]*/chroma://([^/]*)'), 'code__')) THEN regexp_replace(o.source_uri, '^(nxexp://[^/]*)/chroma://', '\1/nx-note://') ELSE o.source_uri END
     WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
       AND (starts_with(o.source_uri, 'chroma://') AND NOT (starts_with(split_part(substr(o.source_uri, 10), '/', 1), 'rdr__') OR starts_with(split_part(substr(o.source_uri, 10), '/', 1), 'docs__') OR starts_with(split_part(substr(o.source_uri, 10), '/', 1), 'code__'))
            OR o.source_uri ~ '^nxexp://[^/]*/chroma://' AND NOT (starts_with(substring(o.source_uri from '^nxexp://[^/]*/chroma://([^/]*)'), 'rdr__') OR starts_with(substring(o.source_uri from '^nxexp://[^/]*/chroma://([^/]*)'), 'docs__') OR starts_with(substring(o.source_uri from '^nxexp://[^/]*/chroma://([^/]*)'), 'code__')));
    IF n > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'RDR-231 note-URI backfill halted and nothing was changed: % live chroma:// note row(s) have a live nx-note:// twin. Start the previous engine binary, merge each pair with POST /v1/catalog/merge, then restart on the new engine. Steps for cloud and local installs: https://github.com/Hellblazer/nexus/blob/main/docs/migration-runbook.md#if-the-rdr-231-note-uri-backfill-halts-startup', n;
    END IF;
END $$;
